title: Platform Engineer – Entry Level Sales Program 2026
reason: Stack +41; Title fit +12; Entry +15; US +10; H1B +8
description_preview:
Introduction
Technology sales at IBM is evolving its way of working to break beyond boundaries with innovative approaches. Preferring to ‘show’ vs. ‘tell’, Client Engineering co-creates with clients, in real-time, on solutions to solve their hardest business challenges.
As a Platform Engineer within Client Engineering, you'll be a key player in a multi-disciplinary team made up of Architects, AI Engineers, Designers, and Business Technology Leaders. The brightest and creative minds collaborating with clients as one team and contributing to experiential working sessions and builds. Your overall objective is to help IBM clients use our technology to solve their business challenges, and to identify what comes next.
Excellent onboarding training will set you up for success, whilst ongoing development will continue to advance your career through its upward trajectory. Our sales environment is fast-paced and supportive. Always part of a team, you'll be surrounded by leaders and colleagues who are always willing to help and be helped – as you support technical activities that compel clients to invest in IBM's products and services.
Your Role And Responsibilities
As a Platform Engineer within IBM Client Engineering, you'll deliver unique client co-creation experiences to accelerate their transformation. You’ll be involved in all aspects of integrated solutions, from identifying requirements to make technical decisions that impact the business case. Your role will be to work with cross-functional teams to realize the full potential of our hybrid cloud and AI solutions and prove business value to our clients.
Your primary responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:
Cloud Expertise: Leverage contemporary hybrid cloud skills (ex. AI, analytics, DevOps, DevSecOps, IaC, security, networking, and storage) with deep industry expertise and understanding of your dedicated set of clients' businesses.
Value Communication: Define and communicate the differentiated value of IBM's technology both technically and commercially.
Technical Leadership: Participate in Lead client sessions that include a broad range of public and hybrid cloud technologies, such as Red Hat OpenShift, IBM Cloud Paks, and Kubernetes.
Solution Support: Support the solutions architecture plan and be a hands-on "builder" in client-facing engagements. Advise on solution architecture to align with platform best practices and focus on our clients’ target environment to ease transition to deployment.
Transition to Deployment: Provide a seamless transition to our clients by working with deployment teams to transition, or perform, the production deployment platform assets and information.
To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Need
Confidence to contact and engage potential new customers and deliver an elevated experience.
Motivation to achieve sales, business objectives and high client satisfaction.
Strong analytic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills combined with an agile process.
Embrace curiosity and a growth mindset.
This position requires you to be in one of the following IBM offices: Chicago IL, New York NY, Raleigh NC, San Francisco CA, and Washington DC.
Readiness to travel up to 50% annually.
IBM will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.
Preferred Education
Bachelor's Degree
Required Technical And Professional Expertise
Technical Education: B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent technical degree/experience.
Programming: Working knowledge in at least one common cloud native programming language (Java, Python, HCL, Rust, Ansible, or language in similar discipline.)
Tech Savvy: Conversant about cloud technology, latest industry trends and how it is being applied to address business challenges.
Team Player: Demonstrates team collaboration and can navigate different communication styles.
Excellent Communication Skills: Possess verbal, written, and interpersonal skills that are engaging,
compelling and influential.
Self-Starter: Growth mindset, motivated to work with clients and can lead projects independently.
Highly Desirable
Experience in deploying and operating solutions on AWS, Azure, IBM Cloud, or Google Cloud.
Relevant technical certifications (e.. CNCF, AWS, IBM Cloud, Azure, Google Cloud, DevOps).

Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Data Scientist III and contribute to global healthcare and scientific innovation. You'll apply advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI techniques to solve complex business challenges across our enterprise. In our collaborative environment, you'll develop and deploy sophisticated data science solutions that drive operational efficiencies and enhance decision-making capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

Software Development & Deployment (Must)
Design, develop, deploy, and maintain enterprise-scale Python applications, including Dash-based analytical and operational applications.
Own application deployment lifecycle from development through production support.
Develop and maintain APIs, backend services, data integrations, and user-facing dashboards.
Partner with scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable software solutions.
DevOps & Cloud Engineering (Must)
Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment, and release management.
Implement DevOps best practices including infrastructure as code, monitoring, logging, and automated recovery.
Deploy and manage applications in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Manage containerized applications using Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
Ensure application reliability, security, scalability, and performance in production environments.
Industrial Connectivity & Data Systems (Preferred)
Design and implement integrations with manufacturing, laboratory, and process automation systems.
Develop solutions leveraging OPC UA, OPC DA, MQTT, and other industrial communication protocols.
Collaborate with automation, manufacturing, and process engineering teams to enable real-time data acquisition and visualization.
Support Industrial IoT (IIoT) initiatives and data platform integrations.
Education
Master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering, or related technical field with 3+ years of relevant experience; OR
Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of relevant experience.
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred.
Required Experience & Qualifications
3+ years of experience developing and deploying production software applications.
Strong proficiency in Python and modern software development practices.
Hands-on experience developing and deploying Python Dash, Flask, or similar web applications.
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
Experience deploying and supporting applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Experience with Docker containers and Kubernetes orchestration.
Strong knowledge of software release management, DevOps practices, monitoring, and automation.
Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, database design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
Familiarity with Linux/Unix administration and scripting.
Experience integrating with OPC UA, OPC DA, MQTT, SCADA, historian systems, or other industrial/IoT platforms. (preferred)
Understanding industrial automation, manufacturing systems, or laboratory informatics environments is highly desirable. (preferred)

Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan

Practice & Potential is an edtech company that works with K-12 students. We want to help all humans live a vibrant, authentic, fulfilling life through having personal, creative, and financial agency. We imagine a world where everyone has the ability to choose between diverse options for school, work, and life to live a life most aligned with their strengths, values, and passions.

We're building the software platform that runs the business: scheduling, billing, session notes, and client portals. We already have built a recurring customer base. Features for the platform will ship to real clients this summer.
What you'll build
You'd own the client-facing feature layer of the platform, working alongside one person on infrastructure and one on a separate pipeline feature. Three of the core features are yours:
Client portal.
The logged-in experience for parents, students, and instructors. Each role sees a different view: parents see upcoming sessions, past session notes, invoices, and ability to schedule classes; students see their own learning history; instructors see their schedule and student roster. Access is gated by a data consent tier that each family sets at sign-up, which controls what gets recorded and stored.
Billing.
Stripe integration for two payment modes: card on file (auto-charged when a session note is approved and sent) and invoice-based (7-day due date with automated reminders). Late-cancel fees apply for cancellations inside 24 hours and need to be tracked and charged automatically. The billing flow is gated on Terms of Service acceptance, which is a hard dependency.
Notifications.
Email reminders 36 hours before each session. Invoice reminders before the due date and after it. The notification system needs to be designed to extend to SMS later, even though SMS is not in scope this summer.
These features connect. A note being approved and sent triggers a charge. A session being rescheduled affects what reminders go out. You'll need to hold that picture as you build.
Stack
React, TypeScript, AWS CDK, Lambda, DynamoDB, Cognito, Stripe. Frontend uses Chakra UI, Tailwind, and React Query.
Qualifications
Required
React and TypeScript: comfortable building components, managing state, and reasoning about data flow between layers. Class projects and coursework count.
REST API construction and consumption: can build a Lambda-backed endpoint and wire it to a frontend, handle errors, and reason about what should live where.
Authentication and authorization: understands JWTs, session management, and role-based access patterns. You'll be building views that show different data to parents, students, and instructors; getting this wrong has real consequences.
Database modeling: can design a schema for related entities (sessions, notes, invoices, users) and think about access patterns before writing code. We use DynamoDB, so NoSQL modeling experience is a plus, but the underlying skill matters more than the specific database.
Asynchronous and event-driven thinking: several features are triggered by other features. A note being approved kicks off a charge. A session being rescheduled affects what reminders go out. You need to be able to reason about these chains before building them.
Git and basic version control hygiene.
Clear written communication. This is a fully async team.
Comfortable using AI tools to speed up development without compromising understanding or quality judgment.
Nice to have
AWS Lambda and API Gateway: can write a serverless function, understand cold starts, and design around the stateless execution model.
DynamoDB: experience with single-table design or at least non-relational data modeling. The access patterns for this platform (get all sessions for a student, get all invoices for a family, get all notes for a session) need to be thought through before the schema is set.
AWS Cognito: user pools, user groups, and JWT-based access control. The consent tier enforcement and role-based portal views depend on this directly.
AWS CDK: infrastructure is defined in TypeScript. You don't need to own it, but you need to be able to read it, add a resource, and not break what's already there.
React Query or SWR: data fetching with caching and cache invalidation matters for a portal where multiple roles see the same underlying data.
Webhook handling patterns: Stripe sends events; you need to verify signatures, handle retries idempotently, and not double-charge anyone.
Who this is for
We're looking for someone who is curious about what they're building and honest about what they don't know. You own not just the task but whether what you built actually works. You notice when something feels off, and you say something.
You plan before you build. When you're stuck, you can describe what you've tried and what you think is going on. When requirements are underspecified, you ask the right questions rather than guessing and moving on.
We use Claude Code Max. We want you to use it as a tool for thinking: to evaluate options, question your assumptions, and understand what you're building, but not as a shortcut around the thinking.
We care more about how you approach problems than your experience level.

This Field Engineer role focuses on commissioning and supporting building automation systems for new construction projects, including K–12 schools, clinics, data centers, and pharmaceutical or bioscience facilities. description_preview:
About Sphere
Every breakthrough in trade infrastructure has followed the same pattern: reduce a transaction cost, expand the market. Containerization for goods. SWIFT for money. Stripe for payments. Compliance is one of the last and largest — and the hardest, because trade rules aren't data to be looked up. They're a complex adaptive system with 190+ sovereign jurisdictions, in different languages, changing constantly, reacting to each other.
Sphere built the system that solves it. Our AI (TRAM) ingests global trade law, interprets it, resolves conflicts across jurisdictions, and produces compliance determinations more reliable than human experts. We handle the entire lifecycle — calculation, registration, filing, remittance — at millisecond latency with zero downtime.
Backed by a16z and YC. $21M Series A, 30%+ month-over-month growth, customers include ElevenLabs, Replit, Deel, Runway, and Lovable.
Small team, global surface area. Everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. San Francisco, five days in office.
The problem keeps compounding. Expanding into input tax, withholding, e-invoicing, tariffs — each multiplies the complexity. Tens of millions of transactions today, billions ahead.
THE ROLE
Sphere is looking for an engineer to lead our internal AI agent enablement efforts. You’ll build the systems that let AI agents safely and effectively increase velocity across. Sphere, starting with engineering and expanding into ops, customer success, tax research, and implementation workflows.
What You'll Do
Within days
Ship AI agent features that help Sphere’s engineering team use agents more effectively and responsibly.
Iterate on versions of Sphere’s agent sandbox environments.
Create workflows where agents can inspect the codebase, run local infrastructure, make changes, run tests, and prepare work for human review.
Work directly with engineers to identify high-leverage internal workflows where agents can create immediate velocity.
Within months
Lead Sphere’s internal efforts to enable AI agents to act more autonomously across engineering, ops, customer success, tax research, and implementation.
Build “Goose” for Sphere: the internal AI agent layer that helps agents understand and operate across Sphere’s systems.
Own the infrastructure, tooling, and workflows that let agents safely take on more complex internal work over time.
Establish the patterns for how Sphere uses agents internally, including context, permissions, review, observability, and escalation.
Requirements
Experience building production-quality software.
Experience in AI agents, coding agents, internal developer tooling, or AI agent enablement.
Comfort working across backend systems, infrastructure, local development environments, CI, and internal tools.
Strong judgment around autonomy, safety, permissions, and human review.
High agency. You can take a vague internal problem and turn it into a working system people actually use.
Strong attention to detail. Agents are only useful here if they improve speed without reducing correctness.
Who You Are
You'll thrive here if:
You're a Dog. You've been underestimated, gone through struggle, and never stopped running. You have a chip on your shoulder and enormous drive. You look at Stripe, Deel, and Flexport all punting on compliance and think: good, that means the opportunity is ours. Hunger beats pedigree.
Early stage is in your bones. You've built things where there's no playbook and nobody handing you the answer. You define the problem instead of waiting for instructions.
You own it end to end. Give you a goal and you figure out your own path. Small team, global surface area — everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. No one tells you how.
You believe speed and accuracy are both possible. We're building a complex product that requires robustness and 100% uptime, and we have to build at our customers' pace. Move fast. Don't break things. Both.
This won't be a fit if:
You need structure handed to you or ambiguity feels draining rather than motivating
You want to manage people more than own hard problems (we're a flat, experienced team — everyone builds)
You're used to "good enough" shipping (small errors have outsized impact here)
Compensation Range: $230K - $260K

description_preview:
About Hike Medical
Hike Medical is reinventing how custom orthopedic products are made. Starting from nothing but a smartphone video, we reconstruct an accurate 3D model of a person's foot and turn it into a custom-manufactured insole — automating a workflow that has traditionally depended on plaster casts, manual measurement, and hand design. We're a Series A company moving fast across AI, 3D reconstruction, computational design, and additive manufacturing, and we're expanding from insoles into the broader world of orthotic and prosthetic (O&P) devices.
The Role
We're hiring a machine learning engineer to work on our Computational Design / CAD to own the parametric design layer behind our products. This person lives between software engineering and product design. The core of the job is translating expert clinical knowledge into parametric systems: sitting with clinicians and design experts, figuring out what the parameter space actually is for a given device, understanding which constraints matter, and encoding all of that into CAD pipelines we can automate and layer AI on top of.
Our design generation (SoleGen) started as an AI-first, end-to-end system trained on thousands of 3D insoles. That approach automates most of our existing designs well, but it struggles to extrapolate to expert-driven design changes and to new device categories where we have little or no training data. Our next chapter is a CAD-driven system with AI on top — procedural, parametric models anchored to anatomical landmarks, with AI predicting the right parameters rather than generating geometry end-to-end. This is the discipline we need you to lead.
You'll work closely with our AI team, our clinical and design experts, and our manufacturing team to build the systems that turn a reconstructed foot and a set of clinical requirements into a manufacturable, custom device — reliably, flexibly, and at scale.
What You'll Do
Design and build parametric, procedural CAD pipelines that generate custom orthopedic devices from anatomical landmarks and clinical parameters.

This is a rare chance to sit at the intersection of frontier vision-language models and real-world deployment. You'll own applied post-training work for VLMs end-to-end for some of the world's largest enterprises, while still contributing directly to Liquid's core multimodal model development.

Takes ownership: Owns VLM post-training projects end-to-end, from customer requirements through delivery and evaluation.

Translate customer requirements into concrete multimodal post-training specifications and workflows.

Independently owns and delivers enterprise VLM post-training projects with minimal oversight.

Overview
As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer II on the Ads Response Prediction team, you will lead the design and development of core ML models that power Instacart’s ads ecosystem. You will tackle fundamental challenges in pCTR modeling such as mitigating selection bias, position bias, and optimizer’s curse in training data, improving model calibration across surfaces and domains, and advancing our multi-task learning and sequence modeling capabilities. Design and implement debiasing techniques such as Mixed Negative Sampling (MNS), Inverse Propensity Weighting (IPW), counterfactual risk minimization, and calibration methods (Platt scaling, isotonic regression) to address systematic prediction biases.
Contribute to the next-generation Multi-Domain Multi-Task (MDMT) model architecture, incorporating innovations like Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), Transformer layers for sequential user behavior, and LoRA adaptors for scalable domain fine-tuning.

Job Description:
Deliver simple solutions to complex problems as a VDI Engineer at GDIT. Here, you'll tailor cutting-edge solutions to the unique requirements of our clients. With a career in application development, you'll make the end user's experience your priority and we'll make your career growth ours.
At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a VDI Engineer you will help ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work depends on a TS/SCI cleared VDI Engineer joining our team to support our intelligence customer in Arnold, MO or Springfield, VA.
How a Vdi Engineer Will Make An Impact
As a Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maintaining a secure, scalable, and highly available enterprise VDI environment supporting users across a global organization. You will serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Citrix and VDI technologies, leading the troubleshooting and resolution of complex performance, availability, and infrastructure issues while driving continuous improvements to the virtual desktop platform.
In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and operations teams to design and integrate enterprise solutions that enhance reliability, performance, and user experience. You will also contribute to identity lifecycle management initiatives, infrastructure automation, and process optimization to improve operational efficiency and service delivery.
The ideal candidate has a proven track record of designing, implementing, and supporting large-scale enterprise VDI environments. You are a self-motivated engineer with exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills who thrives in both independent and collaborative environments. You are passionate about operational excellence, continuous improvement, and delivering secure, resilient, and high-performing virtual desktop solutions that enable organizational success.
Job Duties Include, But Are Not Limited To:
Architect, design, implement, and maintain Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) solutions to support enterprise requirements.
Provide Tier 3 technical support to system administrators by troubleshooting and resolving complex VDI-related issues.
Advise on desktop optimization strategies to ensure platform interoperability and serve as a technical liaison for VDI technologies.
Deliver advanced endpoint support, including troubleshooting and resolution of virtual desktop-related incidents and service requests.
Maintain expert-level knowledge of VDI administration, engineering, implementation, and emerging virtualization technologies.
Operate effectively across multiple, complex production environments while collaborating with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
Apply advanced technical expertise and a comprehensive understanding of related disciplines to support enterprise infrastructure initiatives.
Conduct technical evaluations and trade studies, providing recommendations for architecture, solution selection, and make-versus-buy decisions.
Required Qualifications
WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bachelor's degree with 7+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Extensive experience designing, implementing, administering, and troubleshooting Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (formerly XenDesktop) version 7.x and later.
Strong proficiency with Citrix Provisioning Services (PVS) and Machine Creation Services (MCS).
Working knowledge of user profile management and containerization technologies, including Liquidware ProfileUnity, Microsoft FSLogix, or equivalent solutions.
Experience administering and troubleshooting Citrix ADC (NetScaler) appliances, including load balancing, SSL, and secure remote access configurations.
Experience supporting virtualized infrastructure on VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V, Nutanix, Citrix Xenserver, etc
Strong understanding of Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise networking concepts.
Experience with VDI performance tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and troubleshooting in large-scale enterprise environments.
Familiarity with PowerShell scripting and automation to support Citrix administration and operational tasks.
Ability to analyze complex technical issues, develop effective solutions, and communicate recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
:
Experience administering and managing Microsoft SQL Server environments, including database maintenance, performance monitoring, backup and recovery, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or DSC.
Experience with enterprise monitoring, logging, and analytics platforms such as ControlUp, Citrix Director, Splunk, or Microsoft SCOM.
Familiarity with storage technologies that support VDI workloads, including SAN, NAS, and hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI).
Experience participating in architecture reviews, technology roadmaps, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
Knowledge of security frameworks, vulnerability remediation, and STIG compliance within enterprise Windows environments.
Experience supporting DevOps or CI/CD processes for infrastructure deployments and configuration management.
Demonstrated ability to mentor junior engineers, lead technical initiatives, and collaborate effectively across engineering, operations, and cybersecurity teams.

Join the Technical Fellow Office to solve hard, ambiguous problems, set the bar for technical excellence, and shape how the broader engineering organization builds — across teams and beyond our immediate department. You will work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and the frontier of agentic AI, architecting the platforms, workflows, and guardrails that let autonomous and human-in-the-loop AI systems do real work at scale.
If you want to work where cutting-edge AI meets production-grade engineering — and influence how an entire division builds — this is that role.
What You'll Do
Architect & build: Lead the design of critical systems — agentic pipelines, orchestration platforms, and the services around them — running design reviews and contributing hands-on to development.
Ship agentic systems: Productionize LLM-powered workflows — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, retrieval/knowledge systems, and human-in-the-loop control planes that are reliable, observable, and cost-aware.
Define quality for AI: Build the evaluation harnesses, benchmarks, and automated quality gates that measure and enforce quality in non-deterministic systems, and catch regressions in agent and model behavior.
Incubate new ideas: Rapidly prototype POCs that validate strategic bets, especially at the intersection of AI and existing platforms.
Advise & de-risk: Guide complex technical decisions, help teams adopt AI pragmatically, and avoid the failure modes of hype-driven design.
Surface risks: Identify blind spots, technical risks, and inefficiencies — including the novel risks of autonomous systems — and proactively drive solutions.
Set the technical bar: Write exemplary code across the ecosystem, and raise the level of engineering through architectural reviews, mentorship, and knowledge sharing across teams.
What We're Looking For
10+ years of hands-on engineering in software development, system design, or architecture.
Applied AI / agentic engineering: Real experience with modern LLMs and agentic frameworks — prompt/context engineering, tool use, RAG, orchestration, and evaluation — including the sharp edges (latency, cost, reliability, non-determinism, safety).
Production AI systems: A track record of taking AI/ML-driven features from prototype to production with proper evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails.
Distributed systems & data: Strong background in scalable, fault-tolerant services and in streaming/pipeline technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark).
Cross-functional impact: Ability to drive alignment and technical decisions across teams, and to mentor engineers toward better technical decision-making.

Take problems from ambiguous product or system requirements through clear research questions, hypotheses, and success metrics

Identify and de-risk scaling challenges in your area: data quality, model drift, latency, throughput, cost, safety

Responsible for collaborating with project engineers and managers in the generation and production of structural calculations and drawings for projects involving bridges, walls, culverts, and other civil structures. Perform in-depth structural calculations based on applicable structural codes and local standards.
Prepare computer-generated engineering drawings according to established standards and procedures using latest AutoCAD program.

Revise or change drawings and completes moderate calculations with specific instructions.
Prepare project specifications, summaries of approximate quantities and engineers cost estimates.
Create informational graphic exhibits for internal and external meetings.

Work collaboratively within larger group and have ability to multi-task and assist others in project deadlines.
Prepare supporting calculations, construction specs, and permitting in various jurisdictions.
Work within defined scope, schedule, and budget parameters.
Communicate as appropriate to project managers and project team concerning questions, concerns, progress, and results.
Performs Level 1 quality assurance/quality control.
Competencies
In-depth knowledge of structural finite element and frame modeling software.
Outstanding knowledge of MS Office Suite.
AutoCAD Civil 3D experience preferred.
Outstanding verbal, written and presentation skills.
High attention to detail.
Strong organizational and time management skills.
Ability to work efficiently in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.
Ability to take broad feedback and direction and translate into detailed and highly accurate plans.
Ability to manage data references throughout the duration of projects, from preliminary design and alternative analysis to final design and construction.
Supervisory Responsibility
Assign tasks to and coordinate with entry level engineers and designers.
Plans and coordinated detailed aspects of the engineering work.
Assist with proposals, contracts, and client management.
Prepare scope, schedule, and budget parameters.
Mentor and train staff as needed.
Education And Experience
Undergraduate or graduate degree from accredited program in civil engineering with an emphasis in structural engineering.
Professional Engineering licensure or ability to obtain PE within one year.
Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience with an emphasis in structural engineering.
Strong industry relationships and an understanding of municipal, state, and federal criteria.
Demonstrated project and program management experience.
